document_domain_remediation_scope: A validated same-origin-domain access state and V8 security-token update, with public-suffix checks, active sandbox restrictions, and origin-agent-cluster/permissions-policy behavior, are separate prerequisites. BroadcastChannel must retain its original tuple-origin/storage identity; relaxing channel keys or WindowProxy allowlists is not a correct fix.
psl_behavior: Embedded pinned ICANN and PRIVATE rules are parsed once with libpsl. When unavailable or unusable, the canonical full host is retained as a conservative partition key. No runtime network fetch or build-directory read. Different Chromium PSL revisions can still differ.
